audit_rules: discount_rate must be greater than terminal_growth_rate
method weights must sum to 1.0 within tolerance
currency must be explicit on every method and synthesis output
period must be explicit on every method and synthesis output
provenance must be replay_ready and source URL redacted
acceptance_gates: assumption audit fixture contains no live provider credentials
all audit results pass in deterministic skeleton fixtures
violations are represented as typed audit rows for future provider packages
